teaching_claim: Seven creator-designated whole maneuver files may determine the model, but after the integrity, order, lag, and fit choices are frozen, two separately reset untouched files may judge it only.

responsive_inspection.result: PASS: all nine file names, the reset convention, freeze/no-return boundary, and three rejected alternatives remain distinct at 320 px in both themes.

thumbnail.result: PASS: the amber seven-file training group, central freeze gate, blue two-file validation group, and separate rejected strip remain unmistakable.

protocol_contract.freeze_boundary: A heavy double gate marked NO RETURN separates training-only choices from validation judgment.

visual_contract.layout: Seven discrete training blocks occupy two compact rows, flow rightward through one training-only freeze checkpoint, and terminate at two discrete untouched validation blocks. Rejected alternatives occupy a separate dashed strip.

palette.#e2903a: training group boundaries, tint, and choice heading
palette.#4c8dd6: validation group boundaries, tint, and judgment heading
palette.currentColor: file labels, reset bars, neutral labels, arrows, freeze gate, and rejected marks

visual_contract.non_color_cues: TRAIN and VALIDATE headings, seven-versus-two spatial grouping, nine reset bars, a heavy NO RETURN gate, and three crossed-out rejected labels duplicate the color meanings.
visual_contract.no_fake_data: The blocks are labeled protocol objects only; the SVG contains no waveform, sample, fitted curve, metric, or measured-looking trace.

accessibility.labeling: aria-labelledby references a concise title and a factual description of the seven-file train, freeze, two-file validation, and rejected-split protocol.
accessibility.theme: Neutral text and strokes use currentColor; light and dark renders were visually inspected.

defects: The title did not contain the scan's explicit phrase 'creator-designated files'.
iterations.fix: Changed the visible title to 'Creator-designated files: maneuver partition'.

defects: File labels and reset bars inherited semantic amber or blue instead of the scan's neutral currentColor cue.

iterations.fix: Moved every file label and reset bar to currentColor, retained amber/blue for group semantics, and added role, title, description, and aria-labelledby.
